# SQLite 3.54.1

The two XZ files contain the unmodified SQLite amalgamation and its public header. They originate from the locally available SQLite copy from `libsqlite3-sys 0.40.0`. The build checks the SHA-256 values of the unpacked files against `source.sha256` and statically binds the database engine. The SQLite amalgamation is Public Domain. The TIDE language operations are in `native/bootstrap/sqlite.tide`.
